title: I ended up in the wrong Auditorium and someone was very rude lol
content: So there was a plan to meet up in the Auditorium if we could and I , for once, thought I knew how to get there. I flew in all happy to join a little gathering of people who looked like light angels, or body less people, and I said " Hey guys is this the Auditorium meeting?" And one guy turned to me and sneered and said " does this look like an auditorium to you, idiot" and he was right I had no idea what the difference between an auditorium and a school gym was, apparently so. This isn't the right place, is it. Have you been here , where am I .
